sn35.138:1.1: yaṃ bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ, taṃ pajahatha.
sn35.138:1.2: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
sn35.138:1.4: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ, taṃ pajahatha.
sn35.138:1.5: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn35.138:1.7: sā vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissati. kāyo na tumhākaṃ …pe…
sn35.138:1.9: so vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
sn35.138:1.10: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yaṃ imasmiṃ jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhasākhāpalāsaṃ, taṃ jano hareyya vā ḍaheyya vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā kareyya, api nu tumhākaṃ evamassa,
sn35.138:1.11: amhe jano harati vā ḍahati vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā karotīti.
sn35.138:1.14: na hi no etaṃ bhante attā vā attaniyaṃ vāti.
sn35.138:1.15: evameva kho bhikkhave cakkhu na tumhākaṃ, taṃ pajahatha.
sn35.138:1.16: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn35.138:1.20: so vo pahīno hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
